name: Commerce Usecase Grid
description: Light 3x2 grid of commerce use-case cards. Each card pairs a device mock (browser or phone rebuilt in token CSS/SVG) with an icon, title, and description: Ecommerce (product page + cart popup with Pay), Marketplace (product grid + vendor avatars), Subscription Business (renewal rows with card + calendar chips), Order Management System (paid/unfulfilled rows + a line chart), B2B Store (segmented control + figure), and Point of Sales (a tap-to-pay phone with a card).
interactions: cards fade up in a staggered sweep on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-cug-up, 70ms per card)
cards lift 3px and deepen their shadow on hover (250ms)
prefers-reduced-motion: hover + reveal off, everything rendered in final state
